scenarioName: Pay-cycle window boundary the day before payday
description: The day before the CycleStartDay still resolves into the previous cycle's final week (payday-anchored 7-day windows).

input.userMessage: Reconcile a small 100.00 basket on 2026-06-24 with a pay cycle that starts on day 25.

expectedBehavior.outputFormat: JSON with the current week start and an Ok verdict.
expectedBehavior.decisionCriteria: On the day before payday the current week must anchor to 2026-06-22 (previous cycle's last 7-day window).

scoring.passCriteria: Current week start resolves to 2026-06-22 and the verdict is Ok.
